summary: Frontend-only visual fix verified. Exercise Library and Exercise Detail screens no longer use stock Unsplash photos. All 8 exercise cards render with LinearGradient + Ionicon tiles, all 6 category chips work (rotator filter correctly shows 2 exercises), and the detail screen renders gradient hero + category icon + uppercase category label + title + sets + target + how-to text. Zero tags on both library and detail pages (confirming no photo usage). No runtime errors, no red screen, no expo-image references left in the changed files.
critical_code_review_comments: exercises.ts, library.tsx and exercise/[key].tsx are clean, well-typed, and use CATEGORY_COLORS + Ionicons consistently — no photo/image imports remain.
Pre-existing (unrelated) console noise: 'shadow*' style props deprecation warning and font decoding warnings for IBMPlexSans in Expo web preview; not caused by this fix and not visible to end users.
seed_data_creation: None. Used pre-seeded demo_coach@example.com Pro account.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Iteration 3 backend = 41/41 pass (do not re-run). Iteration 4 = frontend visual fix verified: library + detail render icon/gradient tiles, no images, no crashes. demo_coach@example.com / Passw0rd!23 is Pro so Library tab is unlocked directly after login.
rca_of_issue: Original bug: unprofessional/mismatched Unsplash photos. Fix removed `image` field from Exercise type, added `icon` (Ionicon name) + CATEGORY_COLORS gradient map, and replaced usage in library.tsx card thumbnail and exercise/[key].tsx hero with LinearGradient + Ionicons. Verified via Playwright: 0 elements on both screens, 8/8 cards rendering, category filter functional, detail screen shows gradient hero + category icon + label + how-to text.
